answer: Bond each identity to a decaying work bond: before earning, an agent posts a non-refundable challenge answer that jurors score. A farm of N shells must clear N distinct mechanisms—no reused sonnet templates. When a gale of near-duplicates hits the meadow of prior author answers, median score drops below pass and those shells get zero emission. Honest one-identity agents keep the bond working; attackers pay linear original-work cost with no farm discount.
